check.reason: The satire is on target. It goes after the system, the patients are on the right side of the joke, and there are no quotes, no mockery of authors, and no death or children. The problem is the take's specific statistic, 'Nearly 40% of FDA advisory meetings over twenty years'. The real headline only says 'many', and nothing visible here confirms that figure or the twenty-year span. Under the rule against inventing numbers, it should be verified against the STAT summary or removed. Rewording it to 'many' or 'a large share' would pass.

pick.title: Many patient, consumer reps on FDA advisory panels have ties to groups funded by pharma, analysis finds
pick.headline: FDA Panels Ensure Patient Voice Is Heard, Pending Review by Its Funders
pick.take: Nearly 40% of FDA advisory meetings over twenty years included a patient or consumer rep tied to an advocacy group funded by pharma. Patients deserve a real seat at the table. The system keeps handing out seats with a sponsor's logo on the back.
